profile.name: Ian Xiong
profile.about: Interested in mechatronics, robotics, or computer vision internships for winter 2027!
recommendations: Adam Annosantini “Ian has been a remarkable addition to the team. He’s enthusiastic, energetic, and driven—qualities that make him a delight to work with. During his term Ian implemented two data-processing applications in C#. He translated the requirements into robust solutions. He actively sought feedback and communicated effectively with different stakeholders. He implemented state-of-the art CI pipelines (GitHub Actions) and managed the deployment these applications to a production environment. Of special note was Ian's work on a machine vision project. He developed an algorithm to identify components for robotic pick-and-place processes. With minimal supervision, he learned to use OpenCV (python) and created a robust feature identification and extraction algorithm. Technically, the algorithm is resilient to noise, can identify an arbitrary number of target features, and is agnostic to feature rotation relative to the image coordinate space. Ian also possesses strong interpersonal and communication skills. He presented his work to the broader organization, clearly describing his results in digestible language. He asks insightful questions, actively seeks feedback, and constantly looks for ways to improve. I am confident Ian will be an asset to any organization lucky enough to have him.”
